_comment: Pre-registered wave membership and concurrency (DESIGN.md section 3). launch_wave.sh accepts only a wave name from this file. The canary is the first L1 run launched alone to validate the harness; wave1 is the remaining light runs launched together; wave2 runs the CPU-heavy L3 sessions two at a time in the stated order.
_wave2_relaunch: 2026-09-05 (DESIGN.md section 9): wave2 produced no result on 2026-09-03 (credit refusals; opus5 L3 r1 cut off by print mode's background-task wait ceiling). The void fable51 L3 directories are archived under _void_wave2_credit_refusal/. Pair A of the relaunch is the single permitted resume of opus5_L3_r1 (scripts/resume_run.sh) beside wave2_pairA_fable; pair B is wave2_pairB. Same order and the same two-at-a-time rule as wave2.
_extension_a: Pre-registered 2026-09-05 (DESIGN.md section 11): the OpenAI models gpt-6-astra (tag astra), gpt-5.6-sol (sol) and gpt-5.5 (gpt55) on the same harness through the local gateway, three runs per level each. ext_canary validates the route alone; ext_waveA is every remaining L1 and L2 run; ext_waveB is the nine L3 runs two at a time, interleaved by model so no model gets all the late-night slots.

usage_gate.note: A wave launches only if the latest rate_limit_event across all session logs shows five-hour utilization at or below this value, or its resetsAt is in the past (fresh window).

_extension_b: Pre-registered 2026-09-06 (DESIGN.md section 12): the 20 Extension A cells that ended without a forecast, re-run with the one-shot note prompts/one_shot_suffix.md appended to the prompt on stdin (tags astraos, solos, gpt55os). The seven Extension A runs that wrote a forecast are not re-run (owner instruction), and no Fable 5.1 session is run. ext_b_waveA is the 12 L1 and L2 runs six at a time; ext_b_waveB the eight L3 runs two at a time, interleaved by model.
_extension_c: Pre-registered 2026-09-06 (DESIGN.md section 13): the Opus family on the direct route with the frozen prompts unchanged: Opus 5 reps 2 and 3 (tag opus5, beside its counted rep 1), Opus 4.8 (opus48) and Opus 4.7 (opus47) reps 1 to 3, at every level. Claude-routed, so every wave passes the usage gate; the driver waits and retries when the gate is closed. ext_c_wave1 and ext_c_wave2 split the 16 L1 and L2 runs (four at a time); ext_c_wave3 is the eight L3 runs two at a time, interleaved by model.
_ext_b_relaunch: Dated amendment 2026-09-06 01:15 local (DESIGN.md section 12): five astraos L1/L2 sessions were ended by exhausted API retries on the gateway's 503 auth_unavailable during a network outage of about 00:52 to 00:58 local; archived under _void_ext_b_outage_20260906/ as infrastructure failures and relaunched once, after ext_b_waveA has finished.
_ext_b_relaunch2: Dated amendment 2026-09-06 05:20 local (DESIGN.md section 12): L3 sessions of ext_b_waveB refused by the gateway with 429 (all Codex credentials for the model cooling down) before any tool call are void under section 11 (f), archived under _void_ext_b_cooldown_20260906/ and relaunched once here after the credentials came back.
_ext_c_wave3b: Dated amendment 2026-09-06 10:50 local (DESIGN.md section 13): the six ext_c_wave3 launches of 10:43 local failed at the harness's build check because the pinned Claude Code 2.1.259 binary had been pruned by the CLI's auto-update (no session started, no run directory created); the binary was reinstalled and the six runs are launched here, two at a time, through the usage gate.
